reason: I already put every flyer on Instagram and stories and it works well enough, and my friend does it for me. I don't need another place to post, and I'm not paying for an app nobody is using yet.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? It's not even public yet, so I'd pay €50 a month plus a 3-month minimum for an empty app.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real numbers of local users in my area, and a few venues I know already on it getting people through the door. Then I would take the free month and see.
